text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-gateway-prod severity=critical — 5xx-rate 1m=12.3% (threshold=8%). AlertID=PD123456 https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456

pagerduty-bot: auto-ack by alex.sre (ack at 01:12:20 UTC)

alex.sre: acked, on it. taking lead. @priya @marco can you join? I'll investigate LB + recent deploys.

marco.eng: looking at recent deploys — none in last 15m. checking ingress logs now.

priya.sre: checking kvcache metrics & node OOMs. initial glance: kvcache_evictions spiked in us-west-2 cluster around 01:11:40.

emily.support: saw two customer error reports (support#8972). customers reporting 502s on generation endpoints. tagging for impact.

alex.sre: good catch priya. hypothesis: kvcache eviction -> cold path -> model memory pressure -> OOM -> 502s. immediate plan: 1) reduce canary traffic 2) scale inference pool +2 nodes 3) kick cache warmup job.

marco.eng: running quick checks:
```bash
kubectl -n inference get deploy -o wide
kubectl logs -l app=inference-gateway --since=10m | grep -i '502' | head -n 20
```

marco.eng: logs show repeated "kv cache miss -> model OOM" across pods; sample:
```text
[2026-03-17T01:12:03Z] ERROR gateway request_id=abc123 status=502 reason='kv cache miss + model OOM'
[2026-03-17T01:12:07Z] ERROR gateway request_id=def456 status=502 reason='kv cache miss + model OOM'
```

alex.sre: ok let's scale pool by +2 GPU nodes and patch autoscaler min to avoid thrash. @deploy-bot can you bump dedicated pool target by 2?

deploy-bot: request accepted: scaling redwood-dedicated-pool -> +2 nodes. ETA ~90s.

priya.sre: also lowering canary weight to 0 (route -> primary=100%). applying route patch now.

alex.sre: starting KV warmup replay job targeting hot prefixes. will monitor hit-rate.

marco.eng: warmup showing progress — cache hit rate rising from ~22% -> ~68% in the first 2m.

emily.support: customer impact estimate: ~0.8% of active customers experienced errors; concentrated on US-W region and a couple of high-traffic enterprise tenants. notifications drafted and sent.

alex.sre: 5xx-rate trending down. if >5% after 5m we'll escalate to SEV1 and notify execs. current 5xx-rate reading -> 4.1%.

priya.sre: adding notes to incident ticket PD123456: probable root cause = rapid kvcache eviction on hot prefixes causing cascading model OOMs -> gateway 502s. action items: autoscaler tuning, cache retention policy change, defensive circuit-breaker for model OOMs.

marco.eng: queued a safe patch to prevent large attention-memory spikes on the transformer path; will canary after stabilization.

alex.sre: handing off to @priya for the next 2h rotation. I'll annotate timeline & close on-call tasks. great work team :thumbsup: 

priya.sre: taking over monitoring. will escalate if alarms reappear.

incident-bot: Incident auto-closed: metrics stable for 10m, 5xx-rate below threshold. PD incident PD123456 resolved.
